evaluation_budget.truncation_prevention: Both models evaluate with identical max_new_tokens=1536. Simplicio completes naturally at ~480.5 tokens via EOS, while base model utilizes ~835.0 tokens without truncation.
evaluation_budget.unbiased_code_extraction: Base model outputs are evaluated directly from raw markdown code blocks without requiring proprietary XML tags.

training_accounting.regularization_rationale: Early stopping at max_steps=120 with sequence packing (max_seq_length=2048) and cosine LR decay down to 1e-6 prevented overfitting/memorization across the 10th epoch.

training_pipeline_and_architecture.dataset_curation: 101 high-density multi-language engineering trajectories (Python 45%, TypeScript 25%, Rust 10%, Go 10%, SQL 10%) validated via strict AST syntax checkers.
training_pipeline_and_architecture.loss_masking: DataCollatorForCompletionOnlyLM masks all user prompt tokens, computing cross-entropy loss strictly on assistant response tokens.
training_pipeline_and_architecture.selective_layer_freezing: Freezes layers 0..47 (75% bottom layers) to preserve pre-trained Qwen 27B reasoning, focusing LoRA adaptations on top layers (48..63).
training_pipeline_and_architecture.special_tokens_anchoring: Protocol tags registered as dedicated special tokens in tokenizer to avoid attention dispersion across long contexts.
